name: qector
description: Air-gapped, schema-validated quantum error correction tools for Claude Desktop.
long_description:
QECTOR 2.0.1 provides a local Quantum Error Correction (QEC) tool surface for Claude Desktop through the qector-secure MCP server. The safe profile exposes twelve tools: eight stable decoding, code construction, threshold-sweep, licence and compatibility tools plus four control-plane tools (airgap_status, integrity_check, schema_catalog, audit_log_status). Every returned correction is verified against the parity-check relation H c = s (mod 2); every request and response is validated against JSON Schema 2020-12.

The server is air-gapped by default: it refuses non-loopback sockets, subprocess launches and the opt-in PyPI check inside the process, verifies its own files against INTEGRITY.json at startup, and can write a hash-chained audit log. It uses local stdio only. Research and administrative surfaces are separate opt-in MCP servers and are not bundled into this extension.

The portable bundle requires a local Python 3.10-3.13 environment with the dependencies from requirements.lock installed (scripts/install_offline.sh for air-gapped hosts); the platform-specific '-bundled-' variant vendors them into server/lib.

python_path.title: Python interpreter (optional)
python_path.description: Absolute path to a Python 3.10-3.13 interpreter with qector-decoder-v3 installed. Leave unset to auto-resolve via the bundled launcher.

audit_dir.title: Audit log directory (optional)
audit_dir.description: Directory for the hash-chained JSONL audit log. Leave unset to disable auditing; nothing is written anywhere by default.

tools.name: airgap_status
tools.description: Report the live network posture: air-gap mode, installed guards, scrubbed billing variables and the decoder wheel's native network surface.

tools.name: audit_log_status
tools.description: Report hash-chained audit log state, record count, chain head and validity.

tools.name: build_code_from_matrix
tools.description: Validate and build a binary parity-check matrix; report GF(2) rank and graphlike-ness.

tools.name: compat_report
tools.description: Report runtime compatibility, SDK and Python support windows and the network policy; PyPI freshness is opt-in and refused when air-gapped.

tools.name: decode_single
tools.description: Run one seeded code-capacity decode with Theorem 1 and Theorem 2 checks.

tools.name: decode_syndrome
tools.description: Decode a binary syndrome; fail unless H c = s (mod 2).

tools.name: get_license_info
tools.description: Read the live offline QECTOR license tier, distance limits, and gates.

tools.name: integrity_check
tools.description: Verify every runtime file against INTEGRITY.json (SHA-256).

tools.name: list_code_families
tools.description: List registered quantum code families, live availability and a per-family health probe.

tools.name: list_decoders
tools.description: List stable decoder classes and whether each is graphlike-only.

tools.name: schema_catalog
tools.description: Return the JSON Schema 2020-12 input/output schema of every tool with SHA-256 digests.

tools.name: threshold_sweep
tools.description: Run a code-capacity LER sweep with Wilson 95% intervals and a hashed JSON artifact.
